instruction: Candidate software launch paths: Revit 2025: C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe; Archicad 27: C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad Starter.exe; Abaqus 2025: C:\SIMULIA\EstProducts\2025\win_b64\resources\install\cmdDirFeature\launcher.bat. This environment provides three candidate engineering applications, including BIM-capable applications and a distractor application. Choose an appropriate BIM-capable application yourself. Add Roof to Utility Building. Start from the provided init.ifc by opening it in the selected BIM application. The init model is a relevant but incomplete predecessor; clean, complete, rename, subdivide, or add BIM elements as requested instead of replacing it with unrelated geometry. Build or edit the model using real BIM elements such as Walls, Slabs, Zones, Doors, Windows, Roofs, and Stairs where required; use real BIM elements rather than visual-only detail geometry where the task requires model elements. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using the selected BIM application's built-in IFC export or Save As IFC workflow. Export the complete model as IFC4 and include the Zones/Spaces in the export. The init model contains a one-storey utility building with Zones named UTILITY and STORE but no completed roof. Add a real simple roof over the building and keep the two Zones, doors, windows, walls, and slab as BIM elements. The exported IFC should contain Zones exported as IfcSpace entries named UTILITY, STORE. It should contain at least 1 building storey, at least 2 IfcSpace zones, at least 5 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements, at least 1 IfcSlab element, at least 1 IfcRoof element, at least 2 IfcDoor elements, at least 1 IfcWindow element. The shaped model should have an overall size roughly matching X span 8 m, Y span 5 m, and Z span 3.4 m. The IFC should have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects. Other exact coordinates, room proportions, wall thicknesses, opening positions, materials, library part names, property sets, layers, relationship nesting, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved result.ifc satisfies the stated BIM content.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
